finding.before: The finally block detached cleanup only if the signal was already aborted. Otherwise it awaited iterator.return without listening for an abort that arrived later, retaining the installation lock.
finding.trigger: A candidate source yields one excess byte, fails source-length validation, then its iterator return or reader cancellation remains pending. The caller aborts only after that cleanup starts.
finding.correction: Use the existing nextWithCancellation boundary while awaiting source cleanup. Keep primary validation failure, observe late cleanup rejection, release an explicit reader lock, and allow outer candidate cleanup to finish.

invariants: The old active pointer remains byte-identical; the prior six-member installation can reopen from a fresh store.
The failed candidate is never activated, never becomes the active pointer, and does not remain in staging or installed storage in the exercised cases.
Late cleanup rejection is observed after the caller returns.
No new format, old reader, alternate cleanup implementation or model payload is introduced.
Both existing shells bind the current store script hash; visual markup is unchanged.

reproducer.classification: ordinary bounded development regression, not a material model experiment

baseline.explanation: Each leaf exceeded the 500 ms settle observation bound after cancellation; Node also marks the parent test failed. Finally blocks resolved the held fixture cleanup and allowed each operation to end.

reproducer.boundMeaning: 500 ms unit and 2000 ms browser bounds stop a hanging development test; they are not qualified product latency budgets.

browser.scope: Actual OPFS and Web Locks with a native ReadableStream whose cleanup remains pending until after cancellation; existing persistent cache/restart/tamper contract also passes.
browser.fixtureAuthority: test-only-never-live synthetic member bytes and metadata; never qualified model evidence

limits: Cancellation requires a supplied signal; no new storage deadline was introduced for signal-free callers.
This does not prove all adapter/cleanup failure paths or whole-cache ownership safety. Review ownership admission for unexpected staging/installed entries next.
No real model ran; no qualified default, numerical parity, useful default-model browser conversation, live initial seed, deployment or owner release acceptance is claimed.
lesson: Cancellation must stay attached while cleanup is pending, including finally blocks; test that the next caller can acquire the lock and reopen the prior verified installation.
